references.text: Basic prohibition against making carved images and worshipping them, given in the Ten Commandments
Prohibition against making gods of silver and gold alongside the Lord
Earlier prohibitions in Leviticus against idols and cast images
Moses warns against making carved images in any form
Restatement of the prohibition against carved images in the Ten Commandments
Prohibition against setting up pillars that the Lord hates
Curse on anyone who makes a carved or cast image
Shame upon all who serve carved images and boast about idols
Description of the emptiness of idols - they are works of human hands
The Lord gives no glory to others or his praise to carved images
Prophetic condemnation of idolatry and the making of images
Paul urges that God should not be compared with images made by humans
John urges believers to keep away from idols
